BiblicalUsage: Hezion is a Syrian named once, as the father of Tabrimmon and the grandfather of Ben-hadad. Asa king of Judah sends silver and gold to Ben-hadad the son of Tabrimmon the son of Hezion, asking him to break his league with Baasha and come to Judah's aid.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even a name buried in a genealogy shows how God weaves the nations around His people into His story.
